extension.summary: MegaNexus Hub: the backend and the complete MegaNexus installer.
extension.description: Backend for the MegaNexus interface and skin. Metadata add-ons supply catalog metadata; individually enabled stream add-ons supply sources in their original order. Includes local component installation, account sync, Continue Watching and playback services. Manual bundle ZIP updates only.

extension.news: MegaNexus 9.0.5 - one Library, AI subtitles you can trust, quicker everywhere. - One Library: every saved title once, with the marks of every place it is in; the places, a filter (movies, series, anime) and the order in one row; the day added on each card; no flashing. - AI subtitles: the video's own track in your language goes on first; every translated line on its own time, the whole film, no [sound descriptions]. - Search shows results at once; the top row comes with the cursor; collections open faster. - Hebrew and Arabic subtitles no longer garbled; Next episode never at an episode's start. - Out of the film and back: the Home button keeps it playing, Now playing returns to it. - The Nuvio library sync no longer saves a title twice.

extension.summary: MegaNexus image or animation, custom image/GIF or looping silent video screensaver.
extension.description: Shows the MegaNexus logo, still or animated by the skin (no video player), or use custom artwork or a local/shared MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and other supported video file. Video mode preserves paused media by falling back to artwork. Follows the shared weather and clock visibility preference.
Installs and updates the MegaNexus build (MegaNexus Hub, the MegaNexus interface, MegaNexus Skin and MegaNexus Screensaver) from GitHub Pages. Kodi checks this repository for updates automatically.
